base.flux/sources/gitrepo-external-secrets.ya:
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
metadata:
  name: external-secrets
  namespace: security
spec:
  interval: 5m0s
  url: https://github.com/external-secrets/external-secrets
  ref:
    tag: v2.12.0
base.security/base/external-secrets/helmrelea:
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: external-secrets
  namespace: security
spec:
  releaseName: external-secrets
  driftDetection:
    mode: enabled
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: external-secrets
      sourceRef:
        kind: HelmRepository
        name: external-secrets
      version: "2.12.0"
  interval: 10m0s
  install:
    createNamespace: true
    remediation:
      retries: 3
  values:
    replicaCount: 1
    serviceAccount:
      name: "external-secrets"

    installCRDs: false

    securityContext:
      capabilities:
        drop:
          - ALL
      readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
      runAsNonRoot: true
      runAsUser: 1000

    resources:
      limits:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 150Mi

    prometheus:
      # -- deprecated. will be removed with 0.7.0, use serviceMonitor instead.
      enabled: true
      # -- will be used when we'll deploy the prometheus-operator
    # Feeds grafana-dashboard.yaml. honorLabels keeps the ExternalSecret's own
    # `namespace` label instead of renaming it to `exported_namespace`.
    serviceMonitor:
      enabled: true
      honorLabels: true
      additionalLabels: {}

    podDisruptionBudget:
      enabled: true
      minAvailable: 1

    webhook:
      replicaCount: 1
      prometheus:
        enabled: true
      serviceMonitor:
        enabled: false
        additionalLabels: {}
      resources:
        limits:
          cpu: 100m
          memory: 50Mi
      securityContext:
        capabilities:
          drop:
            - ALL
        readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000

    certController:
      replicaCount: 1
      prometheus:
        enabled: true
      serviceMonitor:
        enabled: false
        additionalLabels: {}

      securityContext:
        capabilities:
          drop:
            - ALL
        readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000

      resources:
        limits:
          cpu: 100m
          memory: 280Mi
